title: 第1366章 举杯敬亡魂第1365章 吾心坦荡
slug: 太古神墟第1974章药园小酌
content_zh:
天玄大地表面上仍是满目焦土，山河沉寂。却有一股磅礴的混元气息，正在天地间悄然弥漫。
霸天城内，新落成的霸天府中，暖意融融，喜气满堂。
夜幕中，巍峨主殿外，串串灵灯高悬。婉转流光熠熠生辉，将整个庭院照得通亮。
庭院中，案几整齐罗列，珍馐灵膳满席，醇厚酒香袅袅弥漫，菜香、酒香沁人心脾。
诸葛俊安排下，众人在此齐聚一堂，开怀畅饮，共祝天玄走出劫难，迎来新生。
酒宴将开，落尘端坐主位，平静的面色中带着一丝哀伤，目光不时飘向忠烈山方向。
诸葛俊自然知道他心中所想，放下手中轻摇的羽扇，开口道：
“主公，这次我们陨落的弟兄，我已亲自安排，每一位都在忠烈山上立下了灵位。
虽然很多人尸骨无存，但英灵永在，与天地同寿。”
寒无涯沉声附和：
“小师弟，不必悲伤，守护天玄哪能没有牺牲。
正是这些兄弟们的牺牲，才保住了天玄，他们死得其所！
况且，我们事先准备很周全，战时的策略也能及时调整，避免了更多弟兄们伤亡。”
落尘点点头，依旧没有开口，眼中却有些湿润。
特意赶来参加宴席的幽冥二护法，赶忙开口：
“主公，我告诉您一个好消息，这次众多阵亡的兄弟们，可以进入轮回。”
“是的，主公，大战还未停息，天玄冥界就重塑成功。
有一些兄弟的残魂还在，很多兄弟可以轮回的。
这相当于他们再次重生，您大可不必悲伤。”
落尘不知觉间眼睛一亮，下意识道：

“可以进入轮回了？好！你们问一下：
如果有人愿意保留着这一世的记忆，就保留下来。
当然，一切顺其自然。”
“遵命！”
幽护法起身抱拳施礼。
落尘突然想起一件事，手一翻，一枚魂晶打造的盒子浮现在掌心。
“幽老，这是我小师姐紫嫣的残魂。
让她尽快进入轮回，不用刻意安排，也顺其自然。
一定要保留她所有的记忆，但这记忆要封禁，十五岁后才可苏醒恢复。”
“一定办到，一定办到！”
幽护法颤颤巍巍接过盒子，小心翼翼收好。
老龟捋捋胡须，悠然点头:
“好！好！紫嫣重生，你们五位师兄妹终于能齐全了。
哈哈，其实，天机阁和九幽用魂种作梗。
却无形中，让尘儿多了一个魅姬，也是冥冥中最好的安排。”
“是，现在想起来一切都是最好的安排，冥冥之中，尘儿自有大气运！
也是尘儿身边所有人和整个天玄生灵的大气运。
我在天玄能遇上尘儿，并成了其护道人，是苍天对我眷顾。”
魏老怪开口道。
他脸色还有些苍白，气息也孱弱，可眉眼间皆是欣喜。

前日，在界灵青韵的引路之下，众人顺利寻得的魏老怪踪迹，将其从崩塌深山下成功救出。
大战那日，魏老怪将灭界珠收入大黑锅中，随机传送远处。
content_en:
The surface of Tianxuan Earth is still full of scorched earth, and the mountains and rivers are silent. But there is a majestic Hunyuan aura that is quietly filling the world.
In Batian City, the newly completed Batian Mansion was filled with warmth and joy.
In the night, outside the majestic main hall, strings of spiritual lanterns were hung high. The gentle stream of light shines brightly, illuminating the entire courtyard.
In the courtyard, the tables and tables are neatly arranged, the tables are filled with delicacies, and the mellow aroma of wine is permeating the air. The aroma of vegetables and wine is refreshing.
Under Zhuge Jun's arrangement, everyone gathered here, drank happily, and wished Tianxuan out of the disaster and ushered in a new life.
The banquet was about to start, and Luochen was sitting at the main seat, with a trace of sadness in his calm face, and his eyes drifted towards Zhonglie Mountain from time to time.
Zhuge Jun naturally knew what he was thinking, so he put down the feather fan he was waving gently in his hand and said:
"Lord, I have personally arranged for our fallen brothers this time, and each of them has their spiritual tablets set up on Mount Zhonglie.
Although many people’s bodies are gone, their spirits will live on forever and live as long as heaven and earth. "
Han Wuya echoed in a deep voice:
"Junior brother, there is no need to be sad, how can you protect Tianxuan without sacrifice?
It was the sacrifice of these brothers that saved Tianxuan, and they deserved their death!
Moreover, we were well prepared in advance and our wartime strategies could be adjusted in time to avoid more casualties among our brothers. "
Luochen nodded, still did not speak, but his eyes were a little moist.
The Second Protector of Netherworld, who came specially to attend the banquet, hurriedly spoke:
"Lord, let me tell you good news. The many brothers who died this time can enter reincarnation."
"Yes, my lord, the world of Heaven, Xuan and Underworld has been successfully reshaped before the war has stopped.
The remnant souls of some brothers are still there, and many brothers can be reincarnated.
This is equivalent to them being reborn again, so you don’t have to be sad. "
Luochen's eyes lit up before he knew it, and he subconsciously said:
"Can you enter reincarnation? Okay! Let me ask you:
If someone wants to keep the memory of this life, keep it.
Of course, everything comes naturally. "
"As you command!"
Youhufa stood up and saluted with his fists clasped.
Luochen suddenly remembered something. He turned his hand and a box made of soul crystal appeared in his palm.
"Youlao, this is the remnant soul of my young senior sister Zi Yan.
Let her enter reincarnation as soon as possible, no need to deliberately arrange it, just let it take its own course.
All her memories must be preserved, but these memories must be sealed and cannot be awakened until she is fifteen years old. "
"It must be done, it must be done!"
Youzhufa tremblingly took the box and put it away carefully.
The old turtle stroked his beard and nodded leisurely:
"Okay! Okay! Zi Yan is reborn, and you five senior brothers and sisters are finally complete.
Haha, actually, Tianji Pavilion and Jiuyou used soul seeds to hinder them.
But invisibly, Chen'er gained another Mei Ji, which was the best arrangement in the world. "
"Yes, now that I think about it, everything is the best arrangement. Somehow, Chen'er has great luck!
It is also the great luck of everyone around Chen'er and all the creatures in Tianxuan.
I met Chen'er in Tianxuan and became his protector. It was God who favored me. "
Wei Wei said.
His face was still a little pale, and his breath was weak, but there was joy in his eyes.
The day before yesterday, under the guidance of Jie Ling Qingyun, everyone successfully found the trace of Wei Wei and successfully rescued him from the collapsed mountain.
On the day of the battle, Old Monster Wei put the World-Destroying Pearl into the big black pot and randomly teleported it to a distant place.
